quest.errand.test.yard.title: Test errand: ask the tea house keeper, visit the training yard, read the notice board
shinobi_progression.quest.retry: Spar lost: %s waits at the spar. Hit your partner to try again
shinobi_progression.quest.blocked: %s is blocked: no %s here. It goes on once that is back
shinobi_progression.shop.away: Stand by the shopkeeper to buy
quest.training.test.first_day.title: Training day: spar in the yard, furnish your flat, sleep
quest.training.test.first_day.step.go_ya: Walk east along the street to the training yard
quest.training.test.first_day.step.spar: Spar with your partner in the yard: attack to strike (sneak-attack for a heavy blow)
quest.training.test.first_day.step.shop: Visit the tea house keeper (west end) for your first furnishing
quest.training.test.first_day.step.furni: Place your furnishing in your flat's main room (3a, upstairs)
quest.training.test.first_day.step.sleep: When night falls, sleep in your bed in flat 3a
quest.story.ch0.title: Ch 0: Cinders
quest.story.ch1.title: Ch 1: A Key and a Bowl
quest.story.ch2.title: Ch 2: Forms
story.ch0.title: §6§lCh 0: Cinders
story.ch0.charm.1: §7§oA small charred wooden charm sits in your palm. Half of a pair.
story.ch0.cell.1: §7§oYou wake on straw in a cave cell. Torchlight. Damp stone.
story.ch0.cell.2: A guard in road clothes raps the bars, an ash-violet scarf at his throat: "Nine. Up."
story.ch0.cell.3: §7§oThrough the bars, the girl in the next cell is awake.
story.ch0.cell.4: The girl, whispering: "They're taking me tonight. Here." She pushes a red cord through the bars. "So someone remembers I was here."
story.ch0.cell.5: §7§oFootsteps. The guards are coming for her.
story.ch0.cell.6: §7§oThey drag her away. She does not cry. You close your hand around the cord.
story.ch0.slip.1: §7§oThe cell's lock is old. An older child showed you the trick years ago.
story.ch0.slip.2: §7§oYou slip out. The guards doze by a brazier; the hideout is emptying, crates stacked, children led out in pairs.
story.ch0.slip.3: §7§oIn the third cell a boy sits with his knees pulled up. Freeing him will cost a minute you may not have.
quest.story.ch0.step.freed_boy: The boy in the third cell:
story.ch0.boy.1: §7§oThe lock gives. The boy grabs your sleeve and does not let go.
story.ch0.raid.1: §7§oShouts. Smoke. Leaf shinobi burst in through the far tunnel.
story.ch0.raid.2: §7§oA cheerful shinobi scoops up two children at once, grinning as if this were a game: the instructor, though you don't know it yet.
story.ch0.raid.3: §7§oA captain drops a guard without a sound, then looks at you for one long second.
ans.sensei.ch0.point: Point to where they took the girl
story.ch0.tunnel.1: §7§oThe captain sends two shinobi down the tunnel you point to. They come back alone: an empty tunnel.
story.ch0.chase.1: §7§oGuards pursue. The squad splits. You follow the captain into the night forest: duck, sprint, climb.
story.ch0.chase.2: §7§oYou pass a burned shrine. A stone watch-fire basket still stands in the ash.
story.ch0.chase.3: §7§oThe captain says nothing. Passing it, you feel warm.
story.ch0.sample.1: §7§oAt the rally point a medic checks every child and touches a paper slip to your hand. A drop of chakra.
story.ch0.sample.2: The medic: "For the records. Everyone gets one."
story.ch0.sample.3: §7§oGreen ink in a ledger. The medic tears off the carbon copy and gives it to you.
story.ch0.ravine.1: §7§oThe rope bridge is cut. The captain lifts you onto their back and walks across the ravine on sticking feet.
story.ch0.ravine.2: The captain, halfway across: "Hold on. We're nearly out."
story.ch0.watcher.1: §7§oOn the far ridge a man in plain road clothes watches you go. He does nothing to stop it.
story.ch0.watcher.2: §7§oHe raises a hand, as if warming it at a fire.
story.ch1.title: §6§lCh 1: A Key and a Bowl
story.ch1.gate.1: §7§oThe great gate of the Hidden Leaf, at night. Four faces carved in the Rock, lit by lanterns.
story.ch1.gate.2: The instructor: "That's where we're going to keep you. The whole place."
story.ch1.office.1: §7§oThe Hokage's office smells of grilled meat. The Fourth crouches to your height.
story.ch1.office.2: The Fourth: "You came a long way. You hungry? Of course you are."
story.ch1.office.3: §7§oHe grants you an orphan's stipend, 30 ryo every morning, 100 for today, and a flat of your own.
story.ch1.office.4: A councillor hands over papers: "Stipend S-114. I saw to it myself." A pine seal on the corner.
story.ch1.office.5: The captain reports in one breath: "The map was good. Unsigned."
story.ch1.office.6: §7§oAt the Fourth's shoulder, an old man does not take his eyes off you.
quest.story.ch1.step.want: The Fourth: "What do you want to be, little one?"
ans.hokage_4.want.strong: Strong enough that no one takes me again
story.ch1.want.after: The Fourth nods slowly, as if filing it away: "Then we'd better feed you first."
quest.story.ch1.step.go_flat: Go to your new flat: 3a, upstairs in the apartment block
story.ch1.porter.1: §7§oA lanky young porter with a burn scar across one palm carries in a crate of bowls.
story.ch1.porter.2: The porter: "First home? I'll fix that sticky door. Doors should open for you."
story.ch1.porter.name: §7§oHe hesitates a moment before he answers, as if he had to remember it.
story.ch1.porter.3: The porter, setting down a tatami: "Put it where you like. It's your room."
quest.story.ch1.step.furnish: Place the tatami in your room
quest.story.ch1.step.sleep: When night falls, sleep in your bed
story.ch1.night.1: §7§oThat night you unpick the charm from your sleeve, look at it a long time, and sew it back in.
story.ch1.ramen.1: The instructor, at your door: "Breakfast's on me. Come on, the ramen stand."
quest.story.ch1.step.ramen: Meet the instructor at the ramen stand (the tea house keeper serves it)
story.ch1.ramen.2: The cook: "Coming up. I'll remember that."
story.ch1.ramen.3: The instructor pays: "The Academy isn't a test, you know. It's a place. Yours too, now."
quest.story.ch1.step.go_academy: Go to the Academy (the training yard, east along the street)
story.ch1.class.1: §7§oThe classroom. Eleven faces turn to look at you.
story.ch1.class.2: §7§oOne draws in a margin. One comes in late with a pup in their jacket. One lends you a pencil.
story.ch1.class.3: §7§oOne sits straight-backed with a wooden sword. One corrects the instructor's arithmetic; one shares rice crackers with everyone.
story.ch1.class.4: A classmate, turning away: "Another one from nowhere."
story.ch1.class.6: §7§oThe class laughs, or doesn't. The instructor beams either way. You have a desk now.
story.ch2.title: §6§lCh 2: Forms
story.ch2.forms.1: §7§oTaijutsu forms in the yard, and throwing at targets.
story.ch2.forms.2: The instructor: "Good! Your guard's high. Yours is fast. You, breathe!"
story.ch2.forms.3: The instructor: "Now pair up. Spar. Getting up after you fall is the whole lesson."
story.ch2.spar.1: §7§oYour sparring partner is the one who said "from nowhere". They are better than you.
quest.story.ch2.step.spar: Spar in the yard: attack to strike, sneak-attack for a heavy blow, guard and dodge
story.ch2.pump.1: §7§oAfter, by the water pump, your rival splashes their face.
story.ch2.pump.2: The rival: "Who taught you to fall like that? Nobody falls like that here."
story.ch2.pump.where: §7§oThey already know where you came from. They only nod.
ans.rival.fall.beat: "You'll have to beat it out of me."
story.ch2.fall.truth: The rival is quiet a while: "...Then you've been fighting longer than me."
story.ch2.fall.nobody: §7§oThey don't believe you, and they don't hide it.
story.ch3.leaf.1: §7§oMorning class in the yard. The instructor hands every pupil a leaf.
story.ch3.leaf.2: The instructor: "Hold it to your brow. No hands. Just chakra. Feel for the warm spot behind your eyes."
story.ch3.leaf.3: §7§oYour leaf sticks. Two desks over, a classmate's leaf keeps flying off; the third time it lands in the instructor's tea.
story.ch3.leaf.4: The instructor: "Good! That warmth is your chakra. Now you'll learn to shape it."
story.ch3.sign.1: The instructor: "The Ram sign. On its own it steadies you and shakes off a trick on the senses. Try it."
quest.story.ch3.step.sign: Weave the Ram sign and release it: hold Weave, press the Ram sign's key, let go of Weave
story.ch3.pair.1: The instructor: "Pairs! Palm to palm, push your chakra into the post together."
story.ch3.pair.2: §7§oYour partner is the classmate who draws in the margins. You press your palms to theirs against an old scorched training post.
story.ch3.pair.3: §7§oYour chakra slides into theirs. For one breath their chakra flares far past what they can do alone: water beads all over the scorched wood.
story.ch3.pair.4: §7§oYour partner stares at the post, then at you.
story.ch3.hushed.1: The instructor claps, a little too fast: "Nice control, both of you! Next pair!"
story.ch3.hushed.2: §7§oAt the window the old man from the Hokage's office is watching. When you look again, he is gone.
story.ch3.hushed.3: Behind you a boy whispers, half to himself: "Your chakra just moved into theirs."
story.ch3.gate.1: §7§oAfter class your partner catches you at the gate.
story.ch3.gate.2: Your partner: "Did you feel that too? It was like you were... inside my chakra. Like a warm room."
quest.story.ch3.step.flare: Your partner waits for an answer:
story.ch3.secret.1: Your partner, grinning: "Our secret, then. The warm room."
story.ch3.medic.1: §7§oA knock. The medic from the rally point, the one with the green ink, smiles in the doorway.
story.ch3.medic.2: The medic: "Just checking on you. Settling in?"
story.ch3.medic.3: §7§oTwo fingers on your pulse. A small notebook.
story.ch3.medic.4: The medic: "Anything strange happen today? Anything at all?"
story.ch3.medic.after: The medic writes something down, snaps the notebook shut and wishes you good night.
ans.medic.flare.tell: Tell the medic about the post
quest.story.ch3.title: Ch 3: The Leaf on Your Brow
story.ch3.title: §6§lCh 3: The Leaf on Your Brow
story.ch4.scratch.1: §7§oLater, coming home after dark, you stop at your door.
story.ch4.scratch.2: §7§oA sinking sun has been scratched into the wood. It still smells of soot.
story.ch4.scratch.3: §7§oOn the roof opposite, a figure in a hood is watching. It turns and runs.
ans.player.ch4.chase.home: Go inside and tell someone in the morning
story.ch4.chase.1: §7§oOver the railing, onto the roofs. The figure moves low and steady, like someone used to carrying heavy things.
story.ch4.chase.2: §7§oYour legs burn. It is long past the hour a child should be asleep.
story.ch4.chase.3: §7§oIt drops into the street and heads for the foot of the Rock.
quest.story.ch4.step.follow: Follow the figure to the foot of the Rock, past the notice board
story.ch4.door.1: §7§oThe figure is gone. There is only a stone door in the cliff: no handle, old seals across it.
story.ch4.door.2: The old man steps out of the dark: "Go home, child. This door is not for you, and neither is the night."
quest.story.ch4.step.rest_sleep: Lock the door and sleep in your bed
story.ch4.late: §7§oYou wake late and heavy. Staying up that long has a cost.
quest.story.ch4.step.night_sleep: Go home and sleep, however late it is
quest.story.ch4.step.morning: Go down and talk to the landlady
story.ch4.morning_after.1: The landlady, brush in hand: "Kids. Don't you worry about it, I've painted it over."
story.ch4.morning_after.2: §7§oIn the stairwell the porter carries a crate for another flat. "Morning!"
story.ch4.report.1: §7§oYou tell the instructor about the mark and the figure on the roof.
story.ch4.report.2: The instructor, cheer gone for a moment: "Show me where it went."
quest.story.ch4.step.follow_rested: Walk with the instructor to the foot of the Rock, past the notice board
story.ch4.door_rested.1: §7§oNo figure, only a stone door in the cliff with no handle and old seals.
story.ch4.door_rested.2: §7§oThe old man is already there, checking the seals one by one.
story.ch4.door_rested.3: The old man: "Go home, child. This door is not for you."
quest.story.ch4.step.door_reply: The old man waits for you to leave:
story.ch4.door_someone.1: §7§oHe looks at the door a beat too long.
story.ch4.door_someone.2: The old man: "No one comes here."
story.ch4.close.1: §7§oThe day goes on as if nothing happened. You keep looking at the paint on your door.
quest.story.ch4.title: Ch 4: Sinking Sun
story.ch4.title: §6§lCh 4: Sinking Sun
story.ch5.chore.1: The instructor: "Chores this week! Yours is the library. The slip's on the notice board."
quest.story.ch5.step.chore: Take your library chore from the notice board
story.ch5.shelve.1: §7§oThe slip sends you to the library: shelve the Academy aptitude scrolls by shelf mark. Leaf 7-iii, Leaf 7-iv...
story.ch5.shelve.2: §7§oBeside some names there is a small brushed circle.
story.ch5.shelve.3: The librarian: "The circles are mine. Children who might need a little more."
story.ch5.page.1: §7§oYou return the founding history to its shelf and turn it over in your hands.
story.ch5.page.2: §7§oA page has been cut out. The edge is fresh and white.
story.ch5.page.3: The librarian goes pale: "That page has been gone for years."
story.ch5.forget.after: §7§oShe nods slowly and takes the book from you.
quest.story.ch5.step.forget: The librarian: "Do you think some things are better forgotten?"
ans.librarian.forget.no: "No. Forgetting is how it happens again."
quest.story.ch5.step.rock: Meet the class at the Academy yard for the tour of the Rock
story.ch5.tour.1: §7§oThe instructor walks the class out under the Rock. Four faces, and four blank spots beside them.
story.ch5.tour.2: The instructor: "One day yours, maybe. Why not? Nobody's face starts up there."
story.ch5.face.after: The instructor laughs, then doesn't: "Good answer."
quest.story.ch5.step.face: The instructor: "Whose face would you put up there, if you could pick anyone?"
quest.story.ch5.title: Ch 5: The Missing Page
story.ch5.title: §6§lCh 5: The Missing Page
story.ch6.study.1: §7§oExam eve. A classmate's family has asked the whole class to study at their table.
quest.story.ch6.step.study: Go to the study night: talk to the family down the street
story.ch6.table.1: §7§oA big table, a family who feeds everyone. One boy brings a tray from his mother's barbecue house; another brings a study plan nobody follows.
story.ch6.table.2: The instructor's notes, passed round: Clone, Transformation, Substitution. "Everyone fails at something tonight. That's the point."
story.ch6.table.3: §7§oBetween bowls, everyone says what their family does and what they want to be.
story.ch6.practise.after: §7§oSmoke, and for a moment you are someone else. The table cheers.
quest.story.ch6.step.practise: Practise Transformation: weave Dog, Boar, Ram
story.ch6.confide.1: §7§oLater, on the step outside, the classmate whose leaf kept flying off sits beside you.
story.ch6.confide.2: Your classmate: "My parent walked out of the village years ago. Never came back. Everyone says missing-nin."
quest.story.ch6.step.parent: Your classmate looks at their hands:
quest.story.ch6.step.sleep: Go home and sleep before the exam
story.ch6.dream.1: §7§oYou dream of the girl in the next cell.
story.ch6.dream.2: §7§oUnder it, another dream: a house with a persimmon tree, and someone singing a song with no words you know.
story.ch6.morning.1: The instructor, at the Academy gate: "Your friend looked troubled last night. Are they all right?"
quest.story.ch6.step.secret: What do you tell the instructor?
ans.player.ch6.secret.tell: Tell the instructor about the parent
story.ch6.kept.1: §7§oAcross the room your classmate catches your eye and nods. They know.
story.ch6.told.1: §7§oAt lunch your classmate won't sit with you. Somebody told.
quest.story.ch6.title: Ch 6: Exam Eve
story.ch6.title: §6§lCh 6: Exam Eve
story.ch7.exam.1: §7§oExam day. Examiners at a long table, the whole class pretending not to be scared.
quest.story.ch7.step.exam: Go to the Academy yard for the graduation exam
quest.story.ch7.step.quiz: The written paper: what does the Ram sign do on its own?
ans.player.ch7.quiz.focus: It steadies you and breaks a trick on the senses
ans.player.ch7.quiz.nothing: Nothing; it only starts other signs
story.ch7.retake.1: The examiner: "Not this time. The paper's set again tomorrow; there's no shame in a second try."
quest.story.ch7.step.retake_sleep: Sleep, then go back to the yard for the retake
quest.story.ch7.step.retake_go: Go to the Academy yard for the retake
story.ch7.throwing.2: §7§oTen practice kunai. Your hands remember the yard: most of them stick.
story.ch7.clone.1: The examiner: "Last part. Clones, please. Take your time."
quest.story.ch7.step.clone: The clone test: weave Ram, Snake, Tiger
story.ch7.protector.2: §7§oThe instructor ties the forehead protector on you personally. It's crooked.
story.ch7.protector.3: The instructor: "Leave it. It's how I'll know it's you."
story.ch7.protector.4: §7§oThey wipe their eyes and say it's dust.
story.ch7.speech.1: §7§oThe yard fills with families. The Fourth climbs onto a bench to speak to the graduates.
story.ch7.speech_strong.1: The Fourth: "Some of you came here wanting to be strong enough that no one takes you again. You are."
story.ch7.speech_safe.1: The Fourth: "Some of you came here wanting somewhere safe. This is it. It's yours to keep safe now."
story.ch7.speech_find.1: The Fourth: "Some of you came here wanting to find someone you lost. Keep looking. The Leaf looks with you."
story.ch7.speech_hokage.1: The Fourth: "And some of you want my job. Good. Come and take it from me one day."
story.ch7.speech_end.1: The Fourth: "From today you're shinobi of the Leaf. The stipend stays, every morning, till you're grown and as long as you need it."
story.ch7.speech_end.2: The Fourth: "The bowl's on me a while longer; the pride's yours."
story.ch7.speech_end.3: §7§oAfter, he finds you by the gate and crouches to your height again.
story.ch7.stipend.after: The Fourth grins: "I'll hold you to that."
quest.story.ch7.step.stipend: The Fourth: "When you're grown, would you keep it going? The stipend?"
story.ch7.seats.1: §7§oNobody has come for your rival. They stand very straight beside an empty space, and leave before the speech is over.
story.ch7.seats.2: §7§oOn the wall, a year-older squad watches the graduates: one cheering too loudly, one silent, one not looking at anyone.
story.ch7.sat.2: §7§oYou sit with them anyway. After a while they stop pretending you aren't there.
story.ch7.watchers.1: §7§oBack in the yard the old man nods to you once, stiffly. The porter is stacking the benches.
story.ch7.watchers.2: §7§oYou are a Genin of the Hidden Leaf.
quest.story.ch7.title: Ch 7: Graduation
story.ch7.title: §6§lCh 7: Graduation
